svg.title: Minimum viable platform landing zone and the readiness check
svg.desc: A large box called Platform landing zone, built once before any workload moves, holds seven numbered boxes: management group hierarchy, baseline policy, a working hub network with hybrid connectivity to the on-premises network, DNS that reaches on-premises name servers, identities that match the workload mix, central logging, and a firewall or equivalent network security control. An arrow leads to a box called Readiness check that lists ten areas. A second arrow leads to a box called First workload landing zone.
svg.text: Built once, before any workload moves.
The minimum viable version has seven capabilities.
